text.description_html:
Omnia 9449/320-US32D, 14 Inch Curved Appliance Pull

Contemporary curved appliance door pull, crafted from high grade solid stainless steel. It requires little maintenance. Designed to enhance any setting where a modern, sophisticated look is desired. This slim elegant stainless steel appliance pull features a textured contemporary curved radius. Manufactured by Omnia, a leader in Stainless Steel hardware for over 40 years.

Specifications for the Omnia 9449/320-US32D Curved Door Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Overall Length: 14-9/16"
  • Center to Center Mount: 12-5/8" (320 mm)
  • Pull Diameter: 3/8" (10 mm) - (Very Slim less than 1/2" diameter)
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

** This item is Discontinued.
